segments.text: Well, here is host of BBC Radio 4's All In The Mind, Claudia Hammond, talking to psychology professor Daryl O'Connor about his Christmas traditions.

segments.text: So actually, I look back on my childhood Christmases

segments.text: we would have to queue up on the stairs

segments.text: When Claudia asks Daryl whether nostalgia influences his present-day Christmases,

segments.text: Daryl responds, indeed it does.

segments.text: This is a common conversational way to say yes or agree with someone.

segments.text: On Christmas morning Daryl asks his children to queue up on the stairs so he can check for Santa Claus just like Daryl father did when he was small And Claudia likes this tradition

segments.text: Dying for something is an informal phrasal verb we use to say that we really want something.

segments.text: Rose-tinted means seeing only the positive parts of something and not the bad parts.

segments.text: Function means the purpose of something.
